data.exact_reserve_text: During 2014 the Syndicate released GBP 77.4m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods, arising predominantly from the Marine, Property and Treaty Divisions (2013: GBP 79.4m, primarily from the Energy and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses in 2014.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1084 reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,332.5m at 1 January 2014. During 2014 the Syndicate recorded a release of prior year technical reserves of GBP 77.4m (5.8% of opening gross claims), driven predominantly by favourable claims development, with the Marine, Property and Treaty divisions the main contributors. The result should be interpreted in the context of a Reinsurance to Close transfer accepted on 1 January 2014 (gross technical provisions GBP 131.7m) which affects comparability of reserve movements and development analyses.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2014 the Syndicate released GBP 77.4m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods, arising predominantly from the Marine, Property and Treaty Divisions (2013: GBP 79.4m, primarily from the Energy and Treaty Divisions).
These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses in 2014.
The total net loss from each of these events is below GBP 10m.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year release (GBP 77.4m) is stated in the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note and taken as the authoritative PYD. A Reinsurance to Close transfer into Syndicate 1084 on 1 January 2014 (gross technical provisions GBP 131.7m) is disclosed and may distort comparisons and any claims development triangle; no gross claims development triangle was provided in the report. Division-level premium splits used (divisional table) rather than regulatory statutory classes.
